messages:
maria: Quick heads up — Nimbus Cloud co-webinar next Wed 10am PT. We need speaker confirmations, demo kiosk plan for marketplace integrations, and a QR-based swag redemption flow. Who can confirm speaker lineup and demo owners?
aj: I can do the product intro + coordinate the SI segment. @ryan can you own demo ops for the kiosk?
ryan: Yep — I'll own kiosk infra. Plan: two kiosks — Hosted API + Private Deployment demos. Need pinned model versions and a small fallback model. Suggest 30-min session: 8min demos each, 10min Q&A.
sara: I can take the Hosted API demo slot. Need slides + a scrubbed demo dataset. Swag: stickers, hoodies (S/M/L/XL), and QR cards. Who's handling shipping and QR vendor?
louise: Events ops here — I'll handle shipping. Note: EU customs forms need 7 business days. We'll use LootBox for QR redemption — they handle codes & inventory.
aj: For the marketplace listing we need a joint offer CTA and a try-demo link. @maria can you confirm landing URL? Also need a 3-step SI integration checklist: ```1. Verify account entitlement
2. Provision demo tenant
3. Upload model snapshot```
maria: Landing currently internal: /nimbus-webinars/redwood-nimbus-demo. I'll get a public URL by Mon. Proposed speaking order: Aj intro -> Sara hosted demo -> Ryan private demo -> Q&A. Can we keep a canary fallback to 13B-quantized if 70B misbehaves?
ryan: Yes — I'll prepare fallback config. Example deploy command for kiosk infra: ```redwood deploy --model=redwood-70b --fallback=redwood-13b-q --region=us-west2 --kiosk=true``` We'll test Tue night.
sara: Slides + notes by EOD Fri. Can someone confirm the demo dataset is scrubbed? Also want to show a quick live compare on latency vs cost in demo.
louise: Swag ops: QR cards will link to LootBox codes. Need a CSV of quantities by region (US / EU / APAC). Who owns estimating numbers?
maria: I'll compile regional attendee estimates and send the CSV by Thu. Also let's add a marketplace blurb about attendee-only discounted dedicated trials.
events-bot: Calendar invite created: Redwood + Nimbus Webinar — 2025-06-18 17:00 UTC. Run-of-show draft uploaded to GDrive: /s/partnerships/nimbus/run_of_show_v1.pdf
aj: :thumbsup: I'll coordinate the SI doc and marketplace CTA. One ask — do we have a promo code to limit swag redemption to registrants?
louise: LootBox supports promo codes. I'll provision code "NIMBUS25" and share credentials out-of-band.
ryan: I'll schedule a dress rehearsal Tue 11am PT to test kiosk failover. Need a simple network checklist: port 443, outbound access to S3 staging, and inbound websocket allowed for live logs.
maria: Added network checklist to run_of_show doc. Tagging @legal — please confirm co-marketing phrasing before we push the public announcement.
legal: We can review copy in 48 hours. Ping me when draft is ready.
sara: Quick note — my slides reference an entitlement token for the demo link. @aj can you generate a short-lived token and post to #secure?
aj: On it. Will post token to #secure later today.
maria: Thanks all. Milestones summary: public landing by Mon, dress rehearsal Tue, swag CSV Thu, speaker slides Fri. I'll post a final checklist and assign owners.
